overall_status: model_level_effective_conductance_counterexample; no new capability, material validation, or priority claim

claims.exact_statement: For every even N=2m with even m>=4 and every 0<epsilon<1, two connected 2m-cycles can have all vertex degrees 2, the same m unit-conductance and m epsilon-conductance edges, and the same opposite source/sink vertices, while their effective conductances are G_A=(1+epsilon)/m and G_B=4 epsilon/[m(1+epsilon)], respectively. Their ratio (1+epsilon)^2/(4 epsilon) is unbounded as epsilon approaches zero. Therefore local degree and edge-conductance histograms alone do not determine or uniformly lower-bound boundary throughput in this reversible linear-response hopping model.
assumptions: Finite undirected graph with fixed topology and positive symmetric edge conductances.
Reversible hopping and linear response near equilibrium, so effective conductance is given by the Dirichlet principle.
Conductance is measured between fixed opposite vertices of the cycle; no alternate bulk or surface path is included.
claims.status: internally_proved_exact_finite_network_result; standard effective-resistance mathematics; no novelty claim and no catalyst validation
claims.novelty_boundary: Rayleigh effective resistance and network rearrangement are established. This is a finite model counterexample to inferring EDL-scale throughput from local coordination/disorder summaries; it neither demonstrates the graph model for a real interface nor claims discovery of H-bond connectivity effects.
claims.costs: The mathematical example has O(N) vertices and edges and uses no fitted data. A physical transfer requires operando spectroscopy, Faradaic/O2 balance, proton-sensitive impedance or flux measurement, catalyst ECSA/state, and sufficiently long AIMD or validated reactive-MD trajectories with uncertainty and autocorrelation accounting. Full-cell voltage is needed for device input work.
claims.falsifier: An arithmetic error in the path resistances or a violation of the fixed reversible linear-response interface would invalidate the proposition as stated. For the proposed experimental extension, if connectivity/time-correlation adds no held-out predictive value beyond matched local coordination and barrier marginals, that extension is rejected.
claims.next_gate: Obtain the cited 2026 study's AIMD/operando data or construct matched reactive trajectories; compare topology-preserving and edge-rewired controls at fixed local statistics, then test held-out proton throughput and O2/Faradaic balance.

claims.exact_statement: For acidic OER with four protons and four electrons per O2 and Faradaic efficiency f, current density j entails proton flux f*j/F and O2 flux f*j/(4F). The 125 mA cm^-2 current-density advantage reported for the 2026 CdO-Co3-xCdxO4 study would correspond to 1.30e-6 mol H+ s^-1 cm^-2 and 3.24e-7 mol O2 s^-1 cm^-2 only if the incremental current is fully Faradaic OER.
assumptions: The reported incremental current is all Faradaic OER for the conditional flux conversion; the paper-specific Faradaic fraction is not independently established here.
claims.status: stoichiometric identity plus unit conversion from source-reported current; no independent experiment or efficiency estimate
claims.proof_path: work/agents/c13_energy_transport/FINAL_REPORT.md, Charge, mass, work, and regime boundary
claims.novelty_boundary: Elementary Faraday/stoichiometry accounting, not a scientific discovery. Anode potential vs RHE is not a full-cell voltage and does not determine device efficiency.
claims.costs: Acquire Faradaic efficiency, O2 flow, full-cell voltage, crossover and heat; without these the current-to-product conversion and energy efficiency remain conditional.
claims.falsifier: A mismatch in the acidic OER stoichiometry or unit conversion would falsify the arithmetic; non-OER current changes the physical proton/O2 flux according to the measured Faradaic fraction.
claims.next_gate: Measure O2 and electron Faradaic balance concurrently with proton-transfer observables under matched operating conditions.
